# Tokens and style helpers

From `@nice-digital/nds-core` 4.1.0. Every colour, space and text size in a sketch
or design must come from here. Raw values (hex colours, px, rem) fail the checks.

```scss
@use '@nice-digital/nds-core/scss/colours';
@use '@nice-digital/nds-core/scss/spacing';
@use '@nice-digital/nds-core/scss/typography';
@use '@nice-digital/nds-core/scss/utils';

.example {
  @include typography.font-size(0);
  color: colours.$text;
  padding: utils.rem(spacing.$small spacing.$medium);
}
```

## Colours: `colours.$name`

Use these alias tokens. The value after the colon is the palette colour it maps to, for reference only.
Tokens named after a component (for example `$tag-...`) belong to that component: prefer the general ones
(`$text`, `$link`, `$border`, `$error`...) in new work.

```scss
@use 'global';

// Text, links, focus
$text: nice-black;
$text-inverse: white;
$link: custom-blue-1;
$link-hover: custom-blue-2;
$link-visited: custom-purple-1;
$link-active: nice-black;
$link-focus: custom-blue-1;
$link-inverse: white;
$link-inverse-hover: white;
$link-inverse-visited: white;
$link-inverse-active: custom-blue-3-tint;
$link-inverse-focus: white;
$code-background: custom-grey-4;
$mark: custom-yellow-highlight;
$focus: custom-teal;
$focus-inverse: white;
$text-print: black;

// Buttons

$btn-cta-hover: custom-yellow-shade;
$btn-cta-text: nice-black;
$btn-cta-border: white;
```

## `spacing`

`@use '@nice-digital/nds-core/scss/spacing';`

```scss
// Extra extra small spacing
$xx-small: 2;
// Extra small spacing
$x-small: 4;
// Small spacing
$small: 8;
// Medium spacing
$medium: 16;
// Large spacing
$large: 32;
// Extra large spacing
$x-large: 48;
// Extra extra large spacing
$xx-large: 64;
```

## `media-queries`

`@use '@nice-digital/nds-core/scss/media-queries';`

```scss
// Extra small break point
$xs: 400px;
// 'Small' break point. Roughly portrait tablets.
$sm: 600px;
// 'Medium' break point. Roughly landscape tablets.
$md: 900px;
// 'Large' break point. Roughly 'dektops'.
$lg: 1200px;
// 'Extra large' break point for wide screens
$xl: 1600px;
```

## `typography`

`@use '@nice-digital/nds-core/scss/typography';`

```scss
// Primary heading. Used for h1 tag but can be used directly
@mixin h1
// Alternative (smaller) heading 1 style
@mixin h1-alt
// Secondary heading. Used for h2 tag but can be used directly
@mixin h2
// Tertiary heading. Used for h3 tag but can be used directly
@mixin h3
// Fourth level heading. Used for h4 tag but can be used directly
@mixin h4
// Fifth level heading. Used for h5 tag but can be used directly
@mixin h5
// Sixth level heading. Used for h6 tag but can be used directly
@mixin h6
// Gets a font family from the `$font-families` map, given a name
@function get-font-family($stack)
// Gets a numeric scale
@function get-scale-integer($scale)
// Gets a numeric font size (in px) from a given scale multiplier.
@function get-font-size($scale)
// Gets a numeric line height from a given scale multiplier.
@function get-line-height($scale)
// Applies font size and line-height for the given scale.
@mixin font-size($scale: 0, $important: false)
// Nice font: includes font size, line height, and margins.
@mixin font($scale, $important: false)
// Default paragraph style
@mixin p
// Lead paragraph style
@mixin lead
// Base list style
@mixin list
// Set and element to display as block and align
@mixin center-block
// The highlight style used for elements like inputs and textareas
@mixin default-error-style($rounded: false)
// Default link style for use on a normal (light) background
@mixin link-default
// Default links for use on a light background
@mixin links-default
// Inverse link style for use on an inverse (dark) background
@mixin link-inverse
// Inverse links for use on a dark background
@mixin links-inverse
// Baseline, in pixels
$baseline: 4;
// Base font size, in pixels
$base-font-size: 16;
// Base line height
$base-line-height: 1.6;
// Default text decoration thickness for link hover
$link-hover-text-decoration-thickness: max(3px, 0.1875rem, 0.12em);
// The font families in use across NICE.
$font-families: ( sans: var(--sans-font-family), serif: var(--serif-font-family), mono: var(--mono-font-family) );
// The modular scale ratio to use for typography
$type-ratio: modular-scale.get-ratio(fourth);
// The minimum root font size, in pixels
$root-font-size-min: 15;
// The maximum root font size, used from breakpoint `$root-font-size-max-breakpoint`
$root-font-size-max: 18;
// The breakpoint at which the root font size starts changing from minimum
$root-font-size-min-breakpoint: media-queries.$md;
// The breakpoint at which the root font size stops changing and is at its maximum
$root-font-size-max-breakpoint: media-queries.$lg;
// A map of named font sizes to their corresponding modular scale factor
$named-font-sizes: ( h1: 6, h1-alt: 5, h2: 4, h3: 3, h4: 2, h5: 1, h6: 0, lead: 2, p: 0 );
// Numeric font sizes
$font-sizes: ( -2: ( fs: 14, lh: 1.6, mb: spacing.$small, mt: spacing.$small ), -1: ( fs: 15, lh: 1.6, mb: spacing.$medium, mt: spacing.$medium ), 0: ( fs: 16, lh: 1.6, mb: spacing.$medium, mt: spacing.$medium ), 1: ( fs: 18, lh: 1.4, mb: spacing.$medium, mt: spacing.$large ), 2: ( fs: 22, lh: 1.3, mb: spacing.$medium, mt: spacing.$large ), 3: ( fs: 28, lh: 1.25, mb: spacing.$medium, mt: spacing.$large ), 4: ( fs: 34, lh: 1.2, mb: spacing.$medium, mt: spacing.$large ), 5: ( fs: 38, lh: 1.2, mb: spacing.$medium, mt: 0 ), 6: ( fs: 44, lh: 1.2, mb: spacing.$large, mt: 0 ) );
```

## `layout`

`@use '@nice-digital/nds-core/scss/layout';`

```scss
// The maximum width of the default container, in pixels
$container-max-width: 1170;
// The gutter for the default container
$container-gutter: spacing.$medium;
// The maximum content width to ensure good readability
$readable-width: 66ch;
// Container placeholder.
@mixin container
// A container within a full bleed/full width component. Need a narrower width to offset the negative margins
@mixin fullWidthContainer
// Make an element adapt its height to fit floated children, and clear floats in both directions.
@mixin clearfix
// Break an element out of its container
@mixin fullWidth
```

## Utility classes

`@nice-digital/design-system/scss/base.scss` is loaded on every page, so the design system's
helper classes are available in markup without writing SCSS, for example `visually-hidden`,
`list list--unstyled`, and spacing modifiers such as `mt--0` and `mb--e`.
